scientific_integrity: Proof gives an unrestricted positive-budget global optimum; finite computer checks are auxiliary. No independent mathematical verification or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only stars with scalar hub actuation and horizon equal to vertex count. Exact maximum is for the finite-step Gramian determinant, not minimum eigenvalue, infinite-horizon energy, or arbitrary networks. Literature-priority comparison is non-exhaustive. Unequal-price optimum is implicitly specified by a strictly concave system.
title: D-optimal minimum-horizon control of priced weighted stars
